previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h~8-14, w~10-16) with: (a) 1-3 CLOSED RECTANGULAR FRAMES (≥3×3) — each a hollow rect outline in a DISTINCT non-{0, 8} color, placed at non-overlapping non-border-touching positions; (b) 0-2 OPTIONAL OPEN FRAMES — hollow rects with ONE SIDE MISSING in other distinct colors. Frames sit at interior positions (border has bg). Rule (FILL ENCLOSED BG REGIONS WITH COLOR 8, LEAVE OPEN FRAMES UNFILLED): every BG-0 cell that is NOT REACHABLE from the grid border via a path of bg-only cells becomes COLOR 8 (cyan). Cells reachable (e.g., interior of open frames is connected to the outside via the missing side) stay 0. Frame cells stay. Net: closed rectangle interiors get cyan-filled; open frames stay hollow.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The stage-A grid and the sizes, bounding boxes, and centers of the newly created color-8 components.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Fill every zero-region that cannot reach the outer border with color 8.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Select the unique largest derived color-8 component and paint a straight color-8 line from its center to the nearest outer border, breaking distance ties top, left, bottom, then right.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Color 8 is absent from every input, so the components ranked by Stage B do not exist until Stage A fills the enclosed holes; substituting the smallest derived component changes the selected start point and final escape path.

parametric_work.summary: Repaired base plus exact-default native family. largest_escape fills enclosed regions, identifies the unique largest newly created cyan component, and routes from its center to the nearest border. Reviewer-side authoring evidence passed; owner qualification and acceptance remain separate.
